|game_text='''0 side — A Stunning Move'''

''Deploy Palpatine's Quarters, Private Platform, and Insidious Prisoner.''<br />
For remainder of game, Sidious and Imperials are lost. Once per turn, may ▼ a Blockade Flagship site. Blockade Flagship may not be ‘blown away.’<br />
While this side up, Insidious Prisoner only follows opponent's characters when moving to Palpatine's Quarters. Once per game, may ▼ (for -2 Force) Cyborg Commander or The Count to a site you occupy.<br />
Flip this card if Insidious Prisoner is on Blockade Flagship.

'''7 side — A Valuable Hostage'''

Immediately ▲ (or retrieve into hand) a [Presence] droid.<br />
While this side up, immunity to attrition of opponent's Jedi, starships, and vehicles is limited to &lt; 5. During your control phase, opponent loses 1 Force for each battleground you control. Once during your turn, may search your Force Pile and reveal any one card; reshuffle. Opponent may lose 2 Force to place that card on bottom of your Used Pile; otherwise, take it into hand.<br />
Flip this card if Insidious Prisoner not at a Blockade Flagship site.
|hatnote=For the later errata text, see [[A Stunning Move / A Valuable Hostage (V) (Virtual Block 7) (Errata)]]. For the current virtual card, see [[A Stunning Move / A Valuable Hostage]].

* '''PC-E1''' ([[A Stunning Move / A Valuable Hostage (V) (Virtual Block 7) (Errata)]]): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) names “Dooku or Grievous” instead of “Cyborg Commander or The Count” on the 0 side<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=50, page 50. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=50 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Deploy Palpatine's Quarters, Private Platform, and Insidious Prisoner. For remainder of game, Sidious and Imperials are lost. Once per turn, may ▼ a Blockade Flagship site. Blockade Flagship may not be ‘blown away.’ While this side up, Insidious Prisoner only follows opponent's characters when moving to Palpatine's Quarters. Once per game, may ▼ (for -2 Force) Dooku or Grievous to a site you occupy. Flip this card if Insidious Prisoner is on Blockade Flagship.” The 7 side is unchanged. The Players Committee had announced the persona change “Cyborg Commander ---&gt; Grievous” on 29 January 2013.<ref name="persona-2013">[https://web.archive.org/web/20130221003512/http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=350&catid=1&Itemid=117 New Persona Changes], [[Players Committee]], 29 January 2013 (“Cyborg Commander ---&gt; Grievous”). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20130221003512/http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=350&catid=1&Itemid=117 Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List slips ([[:File:VL-history-1273-20-front-master.png]], [[:File:VL-history-1273-20-back-master.png]]) and the Players Committee card images ([[:File:VB7-D-astunningmove-pre.gif]], [[:File:VB7-D-avaluablehostage-pre.gif]]) print it.
